struct CommandError <: Exception
    message::String
end
fail(s) = throw(CommandError(s))
check(b, s) = b ? nothing : fail(s)
struct Rectangle
    name::String
    layer::String
    box::NTuple{4,Int}
end
boxtext(b) = "($(b[1]),$(b[2]))-($(b[3]),$(b[4]))"
pointtext(x, y) = "($x,$y)"
rectwidth(r) = r.box[3]-r.box[1]
rectheight(r) = r.box[4]-r.box[2]
rectarea(r) = rectwidth(r)*rectheight(r)
namelist(rects) = isempty(rects) ? "none" : join((r.name for r in rects), ' ')
function margins(a, b)
    x, y, u, v=a.box
    p, q, r, s=b.box
    (p-x, q-y, u-r, v-s)
end
containsrect(a, b) = minimum(margins(a, b))>=0
function relation(a, b)
    x=max(a.box[1], b.box[1])
    y=max(a.box[2], b.box[2])
    u=min(a.box[3], b.box[3])
    v=min(a.box[4], b.box[4])
    ox=u-x
    oy=v-y
    kind=ox>0 && oy>0 ? 0 : ox<0 || oy<0 ? 3 : ox==0 && oy==0 ? 2 : 1
    (
        kind = kind,
        box = (x, y, u, v),
        ox = ox,
        oy = oy,
        gap = max(0, -ox, -oy),
        direction = ox<0 && oy<0 ? "diagonal" : ox<0 ? "x" : "y",
    )
end
connected(a, b) = relation(a, b).kind in (0, 1)
function bounding(rects)
    (
        minimum(r.box[1] for r in rects),
        minimum(r.box[2] for r in rects),
        maximum(r.box[3] for r in rects),
        maximum(r.box[4] for r in rects),
    )
end
function spacinglines(rects, s)
    found=Tuple{Int,String,String,String}[]
    for i in 1:(length(rects)-1), j in (i+1):length(rects)
        a=rects[i]
        b=rects[j]
        r=relation(a, b)
        r.kind==2 && push!(found, (0, a.name, b.name, "corner"))
        r.kind==3 && r.gap<s && push!(found, (r.gap, a.name, b.name, r.direction))
    end
    ["$a $b gap $gap $direction" for (gap, a, b, direction) in sort!(found)]
end
function overlaplines(rects)
    result=String[]
    for i in 1:(length(rects)-1), j in (i+1):length(rects)
        a=rects[i]
        b=rects[j]
        r=relation(a, b)
        r.kind==0 && push!(result, "$(a.name) $(b.name) $(boxtext(r.box)) area $(r.ox*r.oy)")
    end
    result
end
function nets(rects)
    seen=falses(length(rects))
    groups=Vector{Rectangle}[]
    for start in eachindex(rects)
        seen[start] && continue
        pending=[start]
        seen[start]=true
        group=Rectangle[]
        while !isempty(pending)
            i=pop!(pending)
            push!(group, rects[i])
            for j in eachindex(rects)
                if !seen[j] && connected(rects[i], rects[j])
                    seen[j]=true
                    push!(pending, j)
                end
            end
        end
        push!(groups, sort!(group; by = r->r.name))
    end
    groups
end
struct Coverage
    xs::Vector{Int}
    ys::Vector{Int}
    counts::Matrix{Int}
end
function Coverage(rects, extraxs = Int[], extrays = Int[])
    xs=sort!(unique([extraxs; [v for r in rects for v in (r.box[1], r.box[3])]]))
    ys=sort!(unique([extrays; [v for r in rects for v in (r.box[2], r.box[4])]]))
    counts=zeros(Int, length(xs)-1, length(ys)-1)
    for r in rects
        a=searchsortedfirst(xs, r.box[1])
        b=searchsortedfirst(xs, r.box[3])
        c=searchsortedfirst(ys, r.box[2])
        f=searchsortedfirst(ys, r.box[4])
        for i in a:(b-1), j in c:(f-1)
            counts[i, j]+=1
        end
    end
    Coverage(xs, ys, counts)
end
cellarea(c, i, j) = (c.xs[i+1]-c.xs[i])*(c.ys[j+1]-c.ys[j])
covered(c, i, j) = 1<=i<size(c.xs, 1) && 1<=j<size(c.ys, 1) && c.counts[i, j]>0
coveragearea(c, k = 1) = sum(
    (cellarea(c, i, j) for i in axes(c.counts, 1) for j in axes(c.counts, 2) if c.counts[i, j]>=k);
    init = 0,
)
function perimeter(c)
    result=0
    nx, ny=size(c.counts)
    for i in 1:(nx+1), j in 1:ny
        covered(c, i-1, j)!=covered(c, i, j) && (result+=c.ys[j+1]-c.ys[j])
    end
    for j in 1:(ny+1), i in 1:nx
        covered(c, i, j-1)!=covered(c, i, j) && (result+=c.xs[i+1]-c.xs[i])
    end
    result
end
function runs(flags, coordinates)
    result=Tuple{Int,Int}[]
    i=1
    while i<=length(flags)
        if !flags[i]
            i+=1
            continue
        end
        start=i
        while i<=length(flags) && flags[i]
            i+=1
        end
        push!(result, (coordinates[start], coordinates[i]))
    end
    result
end
function holes(c)
    nx, ny=size(c.counts)
    seen=falses(nx, ny)
    result=Tuple{Int,NTuple{4,Int}}[]
    for j in 1:ny, i in 1:nx
        (seen[i, j] || c.counts[i, j]>0) && continue
        pending=[(i, j)]
        seen[i, j]=true
        boundary=false
        area=0
        x=c.xs[i]
        y=c.ys[j]
        u=c.xs[i+1]
        v=c.ys[j+1]
        while !isempty(pending)
            a, b=pop!(pending)
            boundary|=a in (1, nx) || b in (1, ny)
            area+=cellarea(c, a, b)
            x=min(x, c.xs[a])
            y=min(y, c.ys[b])
            u=max(u, c.xs[a+1])
            v=max(v, c.ys[b+1])
            for (p, q) in ((a-1, b), (a+1, b), (a, b-1), (a, b+1))
                if 1<=p<=nx && 1<=q<=ny && !seen[p, q] && c.counts[p, q]==0
                    seen[p, q]=true
                    push!(pending, (p, q))
                end
            end
        end
        !boundary && push!(result, (area, (x, y, u, v)))
    end
    result
end
function pieces(c)
    nx, ny=size(c.counts)
    rows=[runs(c.counts[:, j] .> 0, c.xs) for j in 1:ny]
    result=NTuple{4,Int}[]
    for j in 1:ny, (left, right) in rows[j]
        j>1 && (left, right) in rows[j-1] && continue
        top=j+1
        while top<=ny && (left, right) in rows[top]
            top+=1
        end
        push!(result, (left, c.ys[j], right, c.ys[top]))
    end
    result
end
function largestempty(c)
    nx, ny=size(c.counts)
    best=nothing
    box=nothing
    for a in 1:nx
        free=trues(ny)
        for b in (a+1):(nx+1)
            free .&= c.counts[b-1, :] .== 0
            width=c.xs[b]-c.xs[a]
            for (bottom, top) in runs(free, c.ys)
                candidate=(-width*(top-bottom), c.xs[a], bottom, width)
                if best===nothing || candidate<best
                    best=candidate
                    box=(c.xs[a], bottom, c.xs[b], top)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    box
end
function percentage(area, denominator)
    h=div(10000area, denominator)
    "$(div(h,100)).$(lpad(string(h%100),2,'0'))"
end
mutable struct Layout
    rectangles::Dict{String,Rectangle}
    rules::Dict{NTuple{3,String},Int}
    history::Vector{Tuple{Dict{String,Rectangle},String}}
end
Layout() = Layout(
    Dict{String,Rectangle}(),
    Dict{NTuple{3,String},Int}(),
    Tuple{Dict{String,Rectangle},String}[],
)
sortedrects(w) = sort!(collect(values(w.rectangles)); by = r->r.name)
onlayer(w, layer) = [r for r in sortedrects(w) if r.layer==layer]
function requirelayer(w, layer)
    result=onlayer(w, layer)
    check(!isempty(result), "no rectangles on $layer")
    result
end
function getrect(w, name)
    check(haskey(w.rectangles, name), "unknown rectangle $name")
    w.rectangles[name]
end
unused(w, name) = check(!haskey(w.rectangles, name), "duplicate rectangle $name")
function pair(w, a, b)
    firstrect=getrect(w, a)
    secondrect=getrect(w, b)
    check(a!=b, "same rectangle $a")
    firstrect, secondrect
end
function place!(w, r)
    check(all(x->abs(x)<=10000, r.box), "out of bounds")
    w.rectangles[r.name]=r
end
function report(heading, lines)
    println(heading)
    foreach(println, lines)
end
function ruleviolations(w, kind, layer, other, value)
    kind=="spacing" && return spacinglines(onlayer(w, layer), value)
    result=String[]
    for r in onlayer(w, layer)
        if kind=="width"
            size=min(rectwidth(r), rectheight(r))
            size<value && push!(result, "$(r.name) width $size")
        else
            outers=onlayer(w, other)
            best=isempty(outers) ? nothing : maximum(minimum(margins(u, r)) for u in outers)
            (best===nothing || best<value) &&
                push!(result, "$(r.name) best margin $(best===nothing ? "none" : string(best))")
        end
    end
    result
end
function execute!(w, line)
    parts=String.(split(line, ' '))
    command=parts[1]
    args=parts[2:end]
    before=copy(w.rectangles)
    if command=="ADD"
        name, layer=args[1:2]
        x, y, u, v=parse.(Int, args[3:6])
        unused(w, name)
        check(x<u && y<v, "invalid rectangle")
        r=Rectangle(name, layer, (x, y, u, v))
        place!(w, r)
        println("added $name $layer $(boxtext(r.box))")
    elseif command in ("COPY", "MOVE", "RESIZE", "SPLIT", "LAYER", "DELETE")
        name=args[1]
        r=getrect(w, name)
        x, y, u, v=r.box
        if command=="COPY"
            new=args[2]
            unused(w, new)
            dx, dy=parse.(Int, args[3:4])
            copied=Rectangle(new, r.layer, (x+dx, y+dy, u+dx, v+dy))
            place!(w, copied)
            println("copied $name to $new $(boxtext(copied.box))")
        elseif command=="MOVE"
            dx, dy=parse.(Int, args[2:3])
            moved=Rectangle(name, r.layer, (x+dx, y+dy, u+dx, v+dy))
            place!(w, moved)
            println("moved $name to $(boxtext(moved.box))")
        elseif command=="RESIZE"
            width, height=parse.(Int, args[2:3])
            check(width>0 && height>0, "invalid size")
            resized=Rectangle(name, r.layer, (x, y, x+width, y+height))
            place!(w, resized)
            println("resized $name to $(boxtext(resized.box))")
        elseif command=="SPLIT"
            axis=args[2]
            pos=parse(Int, args[3])
            new=args[4]
            unused(w, new)
            check(axis=="x" ? x<pos<u : y<pos<v, "cut outside $name")
            firstbox=axis=="x" ? (x, y, pos, v) : (x, y, u, pos)
            secondbox=axis=="x" ? (pos, y, u, v) : (x, pos, u, v)
            w.rectangles[name]=Rectangle(name, r.layer, firstbox)
            w.rectangles[new]=Rectangle(new, r.layer, secondbox)
            println(
                "split $name at $axis=$pos: $name $(boxtext(firstbox)), $new $(boxtext(secondbox))",
            )
        elseif command=="LAYER"
            layer=args[2]
            check(layer!=r.layer, "already on $layer")
            w.rectangles[name]=Rectangle(name, layer, r.box)
            println("layer $name $(r.layer) -> $layer")
        else
            delete!(w.rectangles, name)
            println("deleted $name")
        end
    elseif command=="UNDO"
        check(!isempty(w.history), "nothing to undo")
        w.rectangles, original=pop!(w.history)
        println("undo: $original")
    elseif command=="LIST"
        report(
            "rectangles: $(length(w.rectangles))",
            [
                "$(r.name) $(r.layer) $(boxtext(r.box)) $(rectwidth(r))x$(rectheight(r))" for
                r in sortedrects(w)
            ],
        )
    elseif command=="INFO"
        name=args[1]
        r=getrect(w, name)
        others=[s for s in sortedrects(w) if s.name!=name]
        println(
            "$name $(r.layer) $(boxtext(r.box)) $(rectwidth(r))x$(rectheight(r)) area $(rectarea(r))",
        )
        for (label, kind) in (("overlaps", 0), ("touches", 1), ("corners", 2))
            println(
                "$label: $(namelist([s for s in others if s.layer==r.layer && relation(r,s).kind==kind]))",
            )
        end
        println(
            "encloses: $(namelist([s for s in others if containsrect(r,s)]))\nenclosed by: $(namelist([s for s in others if containsrect(s,r)]))",
        )
    elseif command=="LAYERS"
        layers=sort!(unique([r.layer for r in values(w.rectangles)]))
        println("layers: $(length(layers))")
        for layer in layers
            rects=onlayer(w, layer)
            println(
                "$layer: $(length(rects)) rectangles, area $(coveragearea(Coverage(rects))), nets $(length(nets(rects)))",
            )
        end
    elseif command=="OVERLAPS"
        if isempty(args)
            lines=String[]
            for layer in sort!(unique([r.layer for r in values(w.rectangles)]))
                append!(lines, ["$layer $s" for s in overlaplines(onlayer(w, layer))])
            end
            report("overlaps all layers: $(length(lines))", lines)
        else
            lines=overlaplines(requirelayer(w, args[1]))
            report("overlaps $(args[1]): $(length(lines))", lines)
        end
    elseif command in ("INTERSECT", "ADJACENT", "ENCLOSE", "PATH")
        a, b=args
        firstrect, secondrect=pair(w, a, b)
        r=relation(firstrect, secondrect)
        if command=="INTERSECT"
            detail=r.kind==0 ? "$(boxtext(r.box)) area $(r.ox*r.oy)" :
                   r.kind==1 ? "segment $(boxtext(r.box)) length $(r.ox+r.oy)" :
                   r.kind==2 ? "point $(pointtext(r.box[1],r.box[2]))" : "none, gap $(r.gap)"
            println("intersect $a $b: $detail")
        elseif command=="ADJACENT"
            side=r.ox==0 ? (firstrect.box[3]==r.box[1] ? "west" : "east") :
                 (firstrect.box[4]==r.box[2] ? "south" : "north")
            detail=r.kind==0 ? "overlapping" :
                   r.kind==1 ? "$a is $side of $b, edge $(boxtext(r.box)), length $(r.ox+r.oy)" :
                   r.kind==2 ? "corner only at $(pointtext(r.box[1],r.box[2]))" : "not adjacent"
            println("adjacent $a $b: $detail")
        elseif command=="ENCLOSE"
            p, q, r0, s=margins(firstrect, secondrect)
            minimumvalue=min(p, q, r0, s)
            text="margins left $p bottom $q right $r0 top $s"
            println(
                "enclose $a $b: ",
                minimumvalue>=0 ? "yes, $text, min $minimumvalue" : "no, $text",
            )
        else
            check(firstrect.layer==secondrect.layer, "different layers")
            rects=onlayer(w, firstrect.layer)
            distances=Dict(b=>0)
            queue=[b]
            at=1
            while at<=length(queue)
                current=queue[at]
                at+=1
                for other in rects
                    if !haskey(distances, other.name) && connected(w.rectangles[current], other)
                        distances[other.name]=distances[current]+1
                        push!(queue, other.name)
                    end
                end
            end
            if !haskey(distances, a)
                println("path $a $b: none")
            else
                path=[a]
                while path[end]!=b
                    push!(
                        path,
                        first(
                            s.name for
                            s in rects if get(distances, s.name, -1)==distances[path[end]]-1 &&
                                connected(w.rectangles[path[end]], s)
                        ),
                    )
                end
                println("path $a $b: $(join(path," -> ")) ($(length(path)-1) steps)")
            end
        end
    elseif command=="AT"
        x, y=parse.(Int, args)
        found=String[]
        for r in sortedrects(w)
            a, b, c, f=r.box
            if a<=x<=c && b<=y<=f
                sides=(x in (a, c))+(y in (b, f))
                push!(found, "$(r.name) $(r.layer) $(("inside","edge","corner")[sides+1])")
            end
        end
        println("at $(pointtext(x,y)): ", isempty(found) ? "none" : join(found, ", "))
    elseif command=="NEAREST"
        r=getrect(w, args[1])
        others=[s for s in onlayer(w, r.layer) if s.name!=r.name]
        if isempty(others)
            println("nearest $(r.name): none")
        else
            gap, name=minimum((relation(r, s).gap, s.name) for s in others)
            println("nearest $(r.name): $name gap $gap")
        end
    elseif command=="RULE"
        kind=lowercase(args[1])
        layer=args[2]
        other=kind=="enclose" ? args[3] : ""
        value=parse(Int, args[end])
        check(kind!="enclose" || layer!=other, "same layer $layer")
        w.rules[(kind, layer, other)]=value
        println("rule ", join([kind; args[2:end]], ' '))
    elseif command=="CHECK"
        check(!isempty(w.rules), "no rules")
        total=0
        for (kind, layer, other) in sort!(collect(keys(w.rules)))
            value=w.rules[(kind, layer, other)]
            lines=ruleviolations(w, kind, layer, other, value)
            heading=kind=="enclose" ? "$kind $layer $other $value" : "$kind $layer $value"
            report("$heading: $(length(lines)) violations", lines)
            total+=length(lines)
        end
        println("check: $total violations in $(length(w.rules)) rules")
    else
        minimumcount=command=="COVER" ? parse(Int, args[1]) : 1
        layer=args[command=="COVER" ? 2 : 1]
        rects=requirelayer(w, layer)
        if command=="DRC"
            s=parse(Int, args[2])
            lines=spacinglines(rects, s)
            report("drc $layer spacing $s: $(length(lines)) violations", lines)
        elseif command=="NETS"
            groups=nets(rects)
            println("nets $layer: $(length(groups))")
            for (i, group) in enumerate(groups)
                println("net $i: $(namelist(group)) area $(coveragearea(Coverage(group)))")
            end
        elseif command=="RENDER"
            x, y, u, v=parse.(Int, args[2:5])
            check(x<u && y<v, "invalid window")
            check(u-x<=60 && v-y<=40, "window too large")
            println("render $layer $(boxtext((x,y,u,v)))")
            for j in (v-1):-1:y
                println(
                    join([
                        begin
                            count=sum(r.box[1]<=i<r.box[3] && r.box[2]<=j<r.box[4] for r in rects)
                            count==0 ? "." : count>=10 ? "*" : string(count)
                        end for i in x:(u-1)
                    ]),
                )
            end
        elseif command=="BBOX"
            bounds=bounding(rects)
            width=bounds[3]-bounds[1]
            height=bounds[4]-bounds[2]
            println(
                "bbox $layer: $(boxtext(bounds)) $(width)x$height, $(length(rects)) rectangles, density $(percentage(coveragearea(Coverage(rects)),width*height))%",
            )
        elseif command=="DENSITY"
            window=parse(Int, args[2])
            x, y, u, v=bounding(rects)
            nc=cld(u-x, window)
            nr=cld(v-y, window)
            check(nc<=20 && nr<=20, "too many windows")
            coverage=Coverage(rects, [x+i*window for i in 0:nc], [y+j*window for j in 0:nr])
            tiles=zeros(Int, nc, nr)
            for i in axes(coverage.counts, 1), j in axes(coverage.counts, 2)
                if coverage.counts[i, j]>0
                    a=div(coverage.xs[i]-x, window)+1
                    b=div(coverage.ys[j]-y, window)+1
                    tiles[a, b]+=cellarea(coverage, i, j)
                end
            end
            println("density $layer window $window: $(nc)x$nr")
            for j in nr:-1:1
                println(join([div(100tiles[i, j], window*window) for i in 1:nc], ' '))
            end
            for label in ("min", "max")
                best=label=="min" ? minimum(tiles) : maximum(tiles)
                chosen=first((i, j) for j in 1:nr for i in 1:nc if tiles[i, j]==best)
                a, b=chosen
                println(
                    "$label $(percentage(best,window*window))% at $(pointtext(x+(a-1)*window,y+(b-1)*window))",
                )
            end
        else
            c=Coverage(rects)
            if command=="AREA"
                println("area $layer: $(coveragearea(c))")
            elseif command=="COVER"
                println("cover $layer >= $minimumcount: $(coveragearea(c,minimumcount))")
            elseif command=="PERIMETER"
                println("perimeter $layer: $(perimeter(c))")
            elseif command=="EMPTY"
                box=largestempty(c)
                println(
                    "empty $layer: ",
                    box===nothing ? "none" :
                    "$(boxtext(box)) area $((box[3]-box[1])*(box[4]-box[2]))",
                )
            elseif command=="HOLES"
                found=holes(c)
                println("holes $layer: $(length(found))")
                for (i, (area, box)) in enumerate(found)
                    println("hole $i: area $area, bbox $(boxtext(box))")
                end
            elseif command=="MERGE"
                found=pieces(c)
                report("merge $layer: $(length(found)) pieces", boxtext.(found))
            end
        end
    end
    command in ("ADD", "COPY", "MOVE", "RESIZE", "SPLIT", "LAYER", "DELETE") &&
        push!(w.history, (before, line))
end
function main()
    workbench=Layout()
    n=parse(Int, readline())
    for _ in 1:n
        try
            execute!(workbench, readline())
        catch e
            e isa CommandError || rethrow()
            println("error: $(e.message)")
        end
    end
end
main()
